title: Kumihimo braid
summary: Braid a silk cord on a notched disk: move one thread from the lower left up to the top, one from the top right down to the bottom, and turn the disk a quarter turn, again and again.
howToPlay: Eight threads sit in four pairs round the disk.
Tap the lit thread, then tap the ringed notch.
Do both moves and the disk turns by itself.
Braid every turn, then press Check.
rules: Each turn has two moves and a quarter turn of the disk.
Three stars for 88 or more, two stars for 65 and one star for 40.
Doing nothing scores nothing. Watch and learn plays a whole round for you.
heritageNote: Kumihimo is the Japanese art of braiding silk cords. On a notched disk, threads are moved between notches in a fixed order, and a quarter turn of the disk after every pair of moves makes a firm round cord with a spiral of colour.
